localEquivalentCheck.evidence: open-sse/handlers/imageProviders/index.js IMAGE_ADAPTERS has no `fireworks` key and no alias resolving to it; open-sse/providers/registry/fireworks.js declares serviceKinds ["llm", "embedding"] and no imageConfig, so createOpenAIAdapter("fireworks") would have no URL

exports.fireworksImageAdapter: default image adapter instance (guarded generate adapter)
exports.createFireworksImageAdapter: factory; options { timeoutMs, now } for tests
exports.buildFireworksImageRequest: (model, body) -> Fireworks OpenAI-style body; throws status 400
exports.fireworksAcceptedJob: (modality, jobState) accepted-job accounting with unknown cost
exports.fireworksPublicUrl: public https URL check used for results
exports.FIREWORKS_ORIGIN: the only origin the key is sent to

models.publicIds: fireworks/<id>, e.g. fireworks/accounts/fireworks/flux-1-schnell-fp8; the first `/` splits provider from model
models.dynamicDiscovery: none for images in the source; static list only. The existing chat /v1/models fetcher (src/app/api/providers/[id]/models/providerModelsConfig.js) stays on the llm kind.
